name: @andygo.dev/hydra-onix-mcp
stderr:
Usage: hydra-onix-mcp [options] [command]

Hydra Onix MCP for any coding agent: a local stdio proxy with one-time browser
login

Options:
  -V, --version     Show the version
  --verbose         Show diagnostic output and stack traces (default: false)
  -h, --help        display help for command

Commands:
  setup [options]   One-command setup: detect agents, register the MCP server,
                    sign in
  doctor [options]  Check that everything is set up and list the available
                    commands
  auth              Sign in to Hydra and manage the stored session
  mcp               Run or inspect the Hydra MCP relay
  targets           Manage which coding agents are set up
  help [command]    display help for command
